intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independently devised, complex but coherent photorealistic render-test scene in the assigned pre-dawn tidal-observatory domain, using the supplied portrait solely for facial and general appearance continuity while preserving a fully inspectable vertical full-body view and leaving wardrobe topology unspecified for the later phase.

Create a photorealistic vertical full-body editorial photograph at a tidal observatory just before dawn. One unmistakably adult woman whose facial and general appearance follows the provided portrait reference stands on a wet grated calibration platform above receding tidal water, her long dark wavy hair swept behind both shoulders by the damp wind. She calibrates a tripod-mounted optical tide-gauge instrument by aligning its luminous reticle with a numbered reference staff while a nearby readout glows. Sea mist curls through the railings, a distant red beacon diffuses across blue-gray air, wet metal reflects pale cyan instrument light, and brine beads sparkle on the equipment. Keep her stance stable and her hands visibly engaged with the calibration controls. The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame. Frame her large enough for garment inspection while retaining the instrument, reference staff, and misty tidal horizon.
